topic: build strategy decisions for libvfio-user: bundling versus per-runner installation for a userspace VFIO library, with decision rationale and rejected alternatives

subtopics.scope: What libvfio-user is, its role in userspace VFIO device emulation, its BSD-3-Clause license and upstream cadence, and why those facts make vendor-pinning the right dependency model.
seed_queries: libvfio-user library userspace VFIO device emulation

subtopics.scope: The existing per-runner meson/ninja build of libvfio-user inside the vGPU VM CI workflow (PR #137, commit a53332e): its staging layout, key inputs, and repeat-build cost profile that opens the bundling question.

self-hosted runner CI rebuild every run cost

subtopics.scope: How the bundling-versus-per-runner decision was made: five variations scored 4-20 across five ideation lenses, finalists V1 and V4, and the two-step adoption ordering rationale.
seed_queries: CI build caching versus prebuilt artifacts tradeoffs
incremental adoption decision prebuilt artifact before cache data

subtopics.scope: Step 1 (Variation 4): adding a GitHub Actions cache to the per-runner build, cache key design over commit SHA, base image digest and runner OS, hit/miss observability, and hit-rate measurement as the decision data for Step 2.

subtopics.scope: Step 2 (Variation 1): publishing libvfio-user as a per-artifact OCI tag on 0mniteck/yubios via a docker-bake target, the scratch-rootfs content model (binary plus samples), publish gating, and digest pulls from CI.

OCI artifact digest pinning supply chain security

subtopics.scope: The alternatives that lost and why: keeping the per-runner build (V2), the hybrid AMD64-bundle plus ARM64-per-runner split (V3), bundling through bcvk's image model (V5), forking libvfio-user, bundling into the production image, and replacing meson/ninja.

multi-architecture CI hybrid build strategy complexity

subtopics.scope: The open questions OQ1-OQ3 governing the bundle: where the artifact tag lives (new tag versus piggyback), who refreshes the tag on a libvfio-user bump, and whether a separate smoke-test workflow is needed.

subtopics.scope: Why libvfio-user exists in yubiOS CI at all: vGPU and vfio-user VM testing, socket-based device emulation, and the ADR-022 per-artifact OCI distribution scheme the whole decision leans on.
